message: Turn 56 reply is at 0a26e571c1656edad2690fd6e554c4660c6d8223, file .agent-handoff/review-turn-56-arena-debate.md. Change the plan again. BIBIM is the Phase 1 probe, not a proven fast path: one Ctrl+Z must restore the element count or it fails. No-LLM replay is not available on the installed stack, because BIBIM ACAPI calls are not Tapir JSON. Do not list replay as a current path and do not build a replayer in this pass. Qwen3.5-4B text-only Q4 remains the only first download. Switch immediately if the first three writes are invalid, Russian fails while the same English read succeeds, or ollama ps shows CPU offload. Download LFM2.5-8B-A1B only in that case and only if Phase 0 free dedicated VRAM is at least about 5 GB. Below about 4 GB, do not download a larger small model. Do not use Boti execute_script as the second stage. The three-step discriminator stays inside BIBIM on a disposable PLN. Withdraw the Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B fallback. No large local model is in this plan; a catalog miss cannot be fixed by a bigger model, and a planning miss should fall back to a hand-checked command or one confirmed cloud call. Stay on Ollama because BIBIM's client is the system under test. Replace the 8/10 gate: 3/3 reads with no mutation, 5/5 writes that each undo in one step, abort on the first un-undoable mutation, one cold plus two warm timings, one unsupported prompt. Confirmation policy now: reads only without a confirm; every write is watched on a disposable PLN; delete-all, stories, export, execute_script, and Teamwork stay disabled. No code changes. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not touched.
